notes.title: Halloween Sale 25% off, join the bullet hell adventure with us NOW!
notes.content:
[h1]Patch 6 is released![/h1]
[h2]Major Changes[/h2]
[list][*] Auto Save -- The Geekositymag, Zeke and Sakurami Ruby patch! Auto Save and resume is finally added in the game. Resuming a game will not allow you to join the leaderboards, but its very nice for streamers and players who dont have time to play.
[*] Multiplayer -- The HoshiLovi Patch! (They'll hate me for this XD) Because they were playing too "okay" and game was too balanced. XD Made multiplayer abit more harder. Before when only 1 player is left, that player will be as strong as single player fire rate wise. Now its abit weaker. This is so that players cannot fully rely on a strong player.
[*] Score Improvement -- The IssaKimchi Patch! Combo Multipliers now halfs rather than going to 1x when dying in the game.
[/list]

[h2]Improvements[/h2]
[list][*] The usual updated credits, death cards, texts
[*] Fixed background story bugs
[*] Xychi patch - Added keys for F,V,N and T
[*] Certain easter eggs now properly show up at 150 rather than 152
[*] Added tap count on rhythm in the endscreen
[*] Added new chicken easter egg
[*] Added more gamefeel for the  rhythm
[*] Removed chromatic abberation in title screen for people that has sensitive eyes [/list]

This is the 6th patch already since the release.
We'll be hoping to be used to posting the patches here in steam. :D
